title: HeadDropping
description: This plugin makes it so once a player dies they drop they're head. No extra fuss or annoying features.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/048afbeb3ba0771f4cc8eda5e06355d4850d1e86_0.webp)

**What does this plugin do?**

This plugin makes it so if a player dies, they drop they're head, useful for SMP's that want to use player heads as collectables.

**Commands:** 

/headdrops reload - this reloads the headdrops config in-game.

**Config:**


```
#   PLAYER_KILL  - Head drops only when a player is killed by another player.
#   ANY          - Head drops regardless of what caused the death.
#
drop-mode: PLAYER_KILL
```

_report any bugs to: 2in6. on discord_
